dialogues.jp: （さて、起きるか）
dialogues.en: "(Time to get up...)"
dialogues.text: "(Time to get up...)"

dialogues.jp: 「おーい、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Heeey, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Heeey, Nemu."

dialogues.jp: 姿が見えない。
dialogues.en: She's not in the living room.
dialogues.text: She's not in the living room.

dialogues.jp: もう先に行ったのか。
dialogues.en: She must've went on ahead.
dialogues.text: She must've went on ahead.

dialogues.jp: わが妹ながら、朝の強さには感心する。
dialogues.en:
My sister's a morning person by far, something to be
admired.
dialogues.text:
My sister's a morning person by far, something to be
admired.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が買ってきた菓子パンを食べ、学校へと向
かう。
dialogues.en:
I quickly stuffed down the sweetened bun Nemu had bought,
and left for school.
dialogues.text:
I quickly stuffed down the sweetened bun Nemu had bought,
and left for school.

dialogues.jp: （ここはいつも綺麗だよな）
dialogues.en: "(This place is as beautiful as ever.)"
dialogues.text: "(This place is as beautiful as ever.)"

dialogues.jp: 一年中桜が咲き誇る並木道。
dialogues.en:
The year-round blooming of the Sakura petals danced as I
walked down the avenue.
dialogues.text:
The year-round blooming of the Sakura petals danced as I
walked down the avenue.

dialogues.jp:
自然の摂理には逆らっているのかもしれないが
これはこれで、綺麗だ。
dialogues.en:
One of the few occurences of going against mother nature,
it's a beautiful sight regardless.
dialogues.text:
One of the few occurences of going against mother nature,
it's a beautiful sight regardless.

dialogues.jp: （ま、たまに飽きることもあるのだが……）
dialogues.en: "(Although too much of it will surely get tiresome...)"
dialogues.text: "(Although too much of it will surely get tiresome...)"

dialogues.jp:
その時の気分によって、綺麗だったり、花びら
が邪魔だったり。
dialogues.en:
And when that happens, the sakura petals will go from
beautiful to a nuisance in one fell swoop.
dialogues.text:
And when that happens, the sakura petals will go from
beautiful to a nuisance in one fell swoop.

dialogues.jp: 本当、人間なんて勝手なものだ。
dialogues.en: Humans really are the most selfish of God's creatures.
dialogues.text: Humans really are the most selfish of God's creatures.

dialogues.jp: （と、いうより俺がわがままなのか？）
dialogues.en: "(And I just called myself selfish apparently...)"
dialogues.text: "(And I just called myself selfish apparently...)"

dialogues.jp: ま、桜には野郎よりも｛おなご／女子｝だな。
dialogues.en:
Well, the Sakura petals would just be like a girl party to a
selfish boyfriend.
dialogues.text:
Well, the Sakura petals would just be like a girl party to a
selfish boyfriend.

dialogues.jp:
そう思っていると、桜にぴったりな女子が前を
歩いている。
dialogues.en:
As I think that, the sakura petals scatter to reveal a girl
walking in front of me.
dialogues.text:
As I think that, the sakura petals scatter to reveal a girl
walking in front of me.

dialogues.jp: 「おーい。環」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tamaki."

dialogues.jp:
声をかけると、環は長い髪をなびかせながら振
り返る。
dialogues.en:
Hearing my voice, Tamaki's long hair was swept around as she
turned around to face me.
dialogues.text:
Hearing my voice, Tamaki's long hair was swept around as she
turned around to face me.

dialogues.jp: 一瞬、桜の花びらが環に合わせて回る。
dialogues.en: In an instant, the sakura petals twirled around Tamaki.
dialogues.text: In an instant, the sakura petals twirled around Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
風がすっと動いたような、そんな爽やかさが環
から漂う。
dialogues.en:
The wind continued gently blowing around Tamaki, making the
scene look like a work of art.
dialogues.text:
The wind continued gently blowing around Tamaki, making the
scene look like a work of art.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あら、朝倉様。おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "My, Asakura-sama. Good morning to you."
dialogues.text: "My, Asakura-sama. Good morning to you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Ahh."
dialogues.text: "Ahh."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「今日も早いんですね？」
dialogues.en: "You appear to be a bit early today?"
dialogues.text: "You appear to be a bit early today?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "Sorta."
dialogues.text: "Sorta."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ところで、数学の宿題やった？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, did you manage to do the homework for maths?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, did you manage to do the homework for maths?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい、一応は埋めましたが……」
dialogues.en:
"Yes I have. For the time being, I have caught up with all
my homework..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes I have. For the time being, I have caught up with all
my homework..."

dialogues.jp: ラッキー。
dialogues.en: Lucky!
dialogues.text: Lucky!

dialogues.jp: 今日は朝から縁起がいい。
dialogues.en: Today looks like a good day.
dialogues.text: Today looks like a good day.

dialogues.jp: 「マジで？　あのさ、よかったら見せてよ」
dialogues.en: "Seriously? Mind letting me taking a look?"
dialogues.text: "Seriously? Mind letting me taking a look?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あの私、数学はあまり得意では……」
dialogues.en: "Eh? But I cannot say that mathematics is my forte..."
dialogues.text: "Eh? But I cannot say that mathematics is my forte..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺よりはマシだろう。頼む！」
dialogues.en: "No, I'm okay with that. Please?"
dialogues.text: "No, I'm okay with that. Please?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は両手を合わせて拝む。
dialogues.en: I clasp my hands together and plead.
dialogues.text: I clasp my hands together and plead.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "...Very well."
dialogues.text: "...Very well."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、学校着いたらよろしく」
dialogues.en: "Then let's go to class together."
dialogues.text: "Then let's go to class together."

dialogues.jp: と、環と校門まで一緒に行こうとしたその時、
dialogues.en:
Then, just as Tamaki and I were about to reach the school
gates,
dialogues.text:
Then, just as Tamaki and I were about to reach the school
gates,

dialogues.jp: （あれ？　何の音だ？）
dialogues.en: "(Huh? What was that sound?)"
dialogues.text: "(Huh? What was that sound?)"

dialogues.jp: ぎゅるるるる〜。
dialogues.en: --*gyurururu*
dialogues.text: --*gyurururu*

dialogues.jp: お腹の鳴る音……か？
dialogues.en: Sounds like... a rumbling stomach?
dialogues.text: Sounds like... a rumbling stomach?

dialogues.jp: （お、俺のじゃないよな）
dialogues.en: "(Well, it's not mine.)"
dialogues.text: "(Well, it's not mine.)"

dialogues.jp: と、なると……。
dialogues.en: Then it has to be...
dialogues.text: Then it has to be...

dialogues.jp: 隣を見ると、環が赤面して下を向いている。
dialogues.en:
I look to my side at Tamaki, who was looking downwards, her
face red.
dialogues.text:
I look to my side at Tamaki, who was looking downwards, her
face red.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
（こういう時って、女の子にとってはきっと恥
　ずかしいんだろうな）
dialogues.en:
"(These type of situations must be really embarassing for a
girl...)"
dialogues.text:
"(These type of situations must be really embarassing for a
girl...)"

dialogues.jp: ふーむ。
dialogues.en: Hmmm.
dialogues.text: Hmmm.

dialogues.jp: 俺は頭の中で栗饅頭をイメージする。
dialogues.en: I form a picture of a chestnut manjuu in my head.
dialogues.text: I form a picture of a chestnut manjuu in my head.

dialogues.jp: （朝、菓子パン食ってきてよかった）
dialogues.en: "(A sweet bun is usually good for the morning.)"
dialogues.text: "(A sweet bun is usually good for the morning.)"

dialogues.jp: この技はある程度カロリーが無いと辛いからな。
dialogues.en:
That this technique takes up as much calories as you put in
is painful for me.
dialogues.text:
That this technique takes up as much calories as you put in
is painful for me.

dialogues.jp: 右手に栗饅頭が生み出される。
dialogues.en: I finally make a chestnut manjuu appear in my right hand.
dialogues.text: I finally make a chestnut manjuu appear in my right hand.

dialogues.jp: 「これ、よかったら……」
dialogues.en: "Here, you can have this..."
dialogues.text: "Here, you can have this..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
環は、俺の手に乗っている栗饅頭を、不思議そ
うに眺める。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked at the chestnut manjuu in my hand curiously.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked at the chestnut manjuu in my hand curiously.

dialogues.jp: 「毒は入ってねえよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry, it's not poison."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, it's not poison."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え……、でも、いいです」
dialogues.en: "Eh... but is it really okay?"
dialogues.text: "Eh... but is it really okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「遠慮するなって」
dialogues.en: "Don't be so reserved."
dialogues.text: "Don't be so reserved."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、無理やり環に栗饅頭を渡した。
dialogues.en: I placed the bun in Tamaki's hand.
dialogues.text: I placed the bun in Tamaki's hand.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、いただきます……」
dialogues.en: "Well, then thank you.."
dialogues.text: "Well, then thank you.."

dialogues.jp:
環は、恥ずかしそうに俯きながらも、饅頭を口
にする。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki, still embarassedly looking downwards, took a bite
out of the manjuu.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki, still embarassedly looking downwards, took a bite
out of the manjuu.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうだ、うまいだろ？」
dialogues.en: "How is it? Good?"
dialogues.text: "How is it? Good?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おいしい」
dialogues.en: "Very."
dialogues.text: "Very."

dialogues.jp: さっきまでの赤面した顔が、笑顔に変わる。
dialogues.en: The previously red face quickly changed to a smiling one.
dialogues.text: The previously red face quickly changed to a smiling one.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「実は、今日寝坊してしまったんです」
dialogues.en: "Actually, I slept later than I usually would today..."
dialogues.text: "Actually, I slept later than I usually would today..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「でも、だからって朝のお勤めは休めませんか
　ら……実は、ご飯を食べてなくて……」
dialogues.en:
"But I could not shirk from my morning duties at the
shrine... so I had no choice but to skip breakfast..."
dialogues.text:
"But I could not shirk from my morning duties at the
shrine... so I had no choice but to skip breakfast..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: （環って、笑うとやっぱ、かわいいな）
dialogues.en: "(When she's smiling, she's really cute.)"
dialogues.text: "(When she's smiling, she's really cute.)"

dialogues.jp:
上品な雰囲気もいいが、今日のように打ち解け
た笑い方も良い。
dialogues.en:
The atmosphere was lifted quite a bit. On a beautiful day
like today, it's much better to throw off one's reservations
and smile.
dialogues.text:
The atmosphere was lifted quite a bit. On a beautiful day
like today, it's much better to throw off one's reservations
and smile.

dialogues.jp:
環の中の、自然な部分を引き出せた気がして、
ちょっとうれしい。
dialogues.en:
That I managed to pull out the real Tamaki a bit more from
her shell made me feel a little happy.
dialogues.text:
That I managed to pull out the real Tamaki a bit more from
her shell made me feel a little happy.

dialogues.jp:
環を見ると、既に栗饅頭はきれいに無くなって
いた。
dialogues.en:
I look back at Tamaki, to see that she'd already finished
the manjuu.
dialogues.text:
I look back at Tamaki, to see that she'd already finished
the manjuu.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ごちそうさまでした」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much for your treat."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much for your treat."

dialogues.jp:
と環は｛がっしょう／合掌｝した後、突然、俺の顔をまじまじと
見つめる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki clasped her hands in thanks, then suddenly, started
staring intently at my face.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki clasped her hands in thanks, then suddenly, started
staring intently at my face.

dialogues.jp: 何かを、訴えるような瞳……。
dialogues.en: As if she was trying to tell me something...
dialogues.text: As if she was trying to tell me something...

dialogues.jp: 思いつめて今にも何かを語りだそうとしている。
dialogues.en:
I stare back at her, trying to figure out what she's trying
to say.
dialogues.text:
I stare back at her, trying to figure out what she's trying
to say.

dialogues.jp: （な、なんだよ）
dialogues.en: "(Wh, what's going on...)"
dialogues.text: "(Wh, what's going on...)"

dialogues.jp: そんなに見られたら、正直、照れる。
dialogues.en: Staring at her like that made me feel embarassed.
dialogues.text: Staring at her like that made me feel embarassed.

dialogues.jp:
餅のような柔らかそうな頬や、形の良い鼻、ふっ
くらとした唇をひとつひとつはっきり見ること
ができる。
dialogues.en:
My eyes involuntarily moved one by one to her soft cheeks
shaped like buns, her well-formed nose, and those tender
lips.
dialogues.text:
My eyes involuntarily moved one by one to her soft cheeks
shaped like buns, her well-formed nose, and those tender
lips.

dialogues.jp: 思わず環の澄んだ瞳に引き込まれそうになる。
dialogues.en: Finally, her eyes then completely drew mine in.
dialogues.text: Finally, her eyes then completely drew mine in.

dialogues.speaker: Tmaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの、朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Uh, uhm, Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, uhm, Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.jp: 環が、何か言おうとした、正にその時、
dialogues.en: Tamaki started to say something, then,
dialogues.text: Tamaki started to say something, then,

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おにいちゃーん」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chaaan!"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chaaan!"

dialogues.jp: 肝心なところで邪魔が入る。
dialogues.en: The tension level suddenly dropped like a rock.
dialogues.text: The tension level suddenly dropped like a rock.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はにゃ？　何やってるの？」
dialogues.en: "Hanya? What's going on?"
dialogues.text: "Hanya? What's going on?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いや、今、環に饅頭を……それより、何か言
　いかけたよな？」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing, Tamaki was just... did you want to say something,
Tamaki?"
dialogues.text:
"Nothing, Tamaki was just... did you want to say something,
Tamaki?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「い、いえ、何でもありません……」
dialogues.en: "N, no, nothing..."
dialogues.text: "N, no, nothing..."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺から急いで目を反らし、
dialogues.en: Tamaki hurriedly averted her eyes from my gaze.
dialogues.text: Tamaki hurriedly averted her eyes from my gaze.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの、私はこれで」
dialogues.en: "Uhm, I will move on ahead."
dialogues.text: "Uhm, I will move on ahead."

dialogues.jp: と、その場を立ち去ろうとする。
dialogues.en: And just as she was about to leave,
dialogues.text: And just as she was about to leave,

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あー！」
dialogues.en: "Ahhhh~!"
dialogues.text: "Ahhhh~!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「噂の巫女さんだあ」
dialogues.en: "You're that miko everyone's talking about!"
dialogues.text: "You're that miko everyone's talking about!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらは人の良い笑顔を浮かべて、環に声をか
ける。
dialogues.en:
Sakura called out to Tamaki, with a good-natured smile on
her face.
dialogues.text:
Sakura called out to Tamaki, with a good-natured smile on
her face.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、さくら……」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Sakura..."
dialogues.text: "Oy, Sakura..."

dialogues.jp: いくらなんでも『噂の』はまずいだろう。
dialogues.en: I tried to stop her from bringing up the "gossip".
dialogues.text: I tried to stop her from bringing up the "gossip".

dialogues.jp: しかしそんなことは一向にお構いなしである。
dialogues.en: But I was completely ignored, of course.
dialogues.text: But I was completely ignored, of course.

dialogues.jp: ま、さくらなら当然の行動である。
dialogues.en: This was fairly normal behaviour for Sakura.
dialogues.text: This was fairly normal behaviour for Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ねえねえボクも巫女さんの修行してみたい！
　今度、神社に行ってもいい？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, hey, I'm training to be a miko someday! Can I go to
your shrine sometime?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, hey, I'm training to be a miko someday! Can I go to
your shrine sometime?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え……修行はちょっと……」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... training is a bit..."
dialogues.text: "Uhm... training is a bit..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いいでしょ？　いいでしょ？　いいでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Is it okay? Is it okay? Is it okay?!"
dialogues.text: "Is it okay? Is it okay? Is it okay?!"

dialogues.jp: さくらはずいずい、っと環の方に寄っている。
dialogues.en: Sakura started leaning on Tamaki, pleading.
dialogues.text: Sakura started leaning on Tamaki, pleading.

dialogues.jp: 環は完全にさくらのペースに引き込まれている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was completely won over by Sakura's energy.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was completely won over by Sakura's energy.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「……別に、神社に来てもらうのは構わないで
　すけど」
dialogues.en:
"...Well, I do not see any problems if you were to come to
the shrine..."
dialogues.text:
"...Well, I do not see any problems if you were to come to
the shrine..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「やった！！　本当に？　お兄ちゃんも今度一
　緒に行こう」
dialogues.en: "Yeah!! Really?! Onii-chan will go with me too, right?!"
dialogues.text: "Yeah!! Really?! Onii-chan will go with me too, right?!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "A, ahhhhh..."
dialogues.text: "A, ahhhhh..."

dialogues.jp:
願いが叶って大喜びのさくらに、適当に｛あいづち／相槌｝を
打つ。
dialogues.en:
Having her wish just come true, I couldn't do much to spoil
her mood and just became her yes-man.
dialogues.text:
Having her wish just come true, I couldn't do much to spoil
her mood and just became her yes-man.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「では、私はこれで失礼します」
dialogues.en: "In any case, please excuse me."
dialogues.text: "In any case, please excuse me."

dialogues.jp: 環はその場を去り、先に学校へと入っていく。
dialogues.en: Tamaki then left for school ahead of us.
dialogues.text: Tamaki then left for school ahead of us.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「はにゃ。お急ぎみたいだね。それとも、ボク
　何か悪いことしたかな？」
dialogues.en: "Hanya. She really rushed off. Did I say something bad?"
dialogues.text: "Hanya. She really rushed off. Did I say something bad?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ま、大丈夫だろ」
dialogues.en: "Nah, it's alright."
dialogues.text: "Nah, it's alright."

dialogues.jp:
環がさっき言おうとしたことは、一体何だった
のだろう。
dialogues.en:
Although now I really wonder what Tamaki was trying to say
earlier.
dialogues.text:
Although now I really wonder what Tamaki was trying to say
earlier.

dialogues.jp: ま、いっか。
dialogues.en: Well, whatever.
dialogues.text: Well, whatever.

dialogues.jp: ◆お腹の音と栗饅頭◆
dialogues.en: ◆The rumbling stomach and the chestnut manjuu◆
dialogues.text: ◆The rumbling stomach and the chestnut manjuu◆

dialogues.jp:
朝、桜並木で環と会うと、環のお腹の音を聞い
てしまう。
dialogues.en:
In the morning, I met Tamaki on the Sakura Avenue, and heard
her stomach rumbling.
dialogues.text:
In the morning, I met Tamaki on the Sakura Avenue, and heard
her stomach rumbling.

dialogues.jp:
環に栗饅頭を出してやると、おいしいと自然な
笑いを見せる。
dialogues.en:
I produced a chestnut manjuu for her to eat, and her
spontaneous smile and claim of deliciousness was more than
enough thanks.
dialogues.text:
I produced a chestnut manjuu for her to eat, and her
spontaneous smile and claim of deliciousness was more than
enough thanks.

dialogues.jp:
俺に何かを言おうとしたが、さくらが来ると、
さっさと先に学校へ行ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
She was about to say something to me, but Sakura interrupted
the moment, and Tamaki left ahead towards school quickly.
dialogues.text:
She was about to say something to me, but Sakura interrupted
the moment, and Tamaki left ahead towards school quickly.
